title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Live-in carer This service provides for a person who either lives in the house of the participant or travels with the participant. The service provides assistance with, and/or supervision of, personal tasks of daily life to develop skills of the participant to live as autonomously as possible. Our services include Personal Care The carer assists with bathing, dressing, and grooming, promoting the participant’s hygiene and self-esteem. This includes skin care, oral hygiene, and hair care, tailored to individual abilities and preferences. Personal care is crucial for maintaining good health and a positive self-image. Meal Preparation The carer prepares balanced, nutritious meals, catering to specific dietary needs and preferences. This includes planning meals, cooking, and aiding with eating if necessary. The focus is on ensuring participants enjoy healthy, tasty meals that meet their dietary requirements. Grocery Shopping The carer assists with grocery shopping, selecting items that align with the participant’s dietary needs and personal preferences. This involves planning meals, managing budgets, and ensuring a steady supply of necessary groceries and household items. Medication Management Managing medication involves ensuring timely intake, keeping track of prescriptions, and monitoring for side effects. The carer assists with organising medications, understanding dosage instructions, and liaising with healthcare providers as needed. Housekeeping Light housekeeping duties include cleaning, doing laundry, and maintaining an orderly environment. This ensures the participant’s living space is clean, safe, and comfortable, which is vital for their wellbeing and quality of life. Companionship Offering companionship involves engaging in conversations, participating in hobbies or interests, and providing emotional support. This social interaction is vital for mental health, reducing feelings of isolation and loneliness. Mobility Assistance The carer assists with walking, transfers, and using mobility aids. This includes helping the participant move around their home safely and comfortably, and may involve exercises to maintain or improve mobility.
